id: title:frankh:stop the trace waterfall jumping when the pinned bar appears

review.posthog_relevance: Adds scroll-aware ancestor selection and sticky bar visibility to the frontend, improving the user's ability to interpret hierarchical results and manage ancestor context while scrolling.
review.reason: The observed changes implement a pinned ancestor bar, ancestor-count display, and scroll-dependent ancestor visibility. P1.F1.H1 adds a test for pinned ancestor visibility and scroll behavior. P1.F2.H2 adds a constant for pinned bar height. P1.F2.H3 adds a scrollRows helper and updates scrolledPastAncestors to use it. P1.F2.H4 adds scrollRows state. This is a narrow, localized UI/"
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the observed implementation of scroll-aware ancestor selection and sticky bar visibility, which is a bounded capability. However, the actual benefit and user adoption are not demonstrated. No tier assignment is made; this is an observation-only pass.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No adoption, incident, or effort claims are supported. No tier assignment is made; this is an observation-only pass.

observations.behavior: Adds a pinned ancestor bar and scroll-aware ancestor selection, including a sticky bar, ancestor-count display, and scroll-dependent ancestor visibility. P1.F1.H1 adds a test for pinned ancestor visibility and scroll behavior. P1.F2.H2 adds a constant for pinned bar height. P1.F2.H3 adds a scrollRows helper and updates scrolledPastAncestors to use it. P1.F2.H4 adds scrollRows state
